hook.headline: 31 new beers in September
hook.teaser: One of these scored 1/10. Stay for the best.

countdown.name: HaNoi Homebrew Citra Fog
countdown.quote: Pineapple and apricot come together as a delicious blend
countdown.longQuote: Light on the haze but full on with the fruit. Pineapple and apricot come together as a delicious blend. I went through it way too soon

countdown.name: Philter Sydney Stout
countdown.quote: A beer I could either sit on or skull
countdown.longQuote: Creamy with a light finish. Similar to Guinness but less bitter. A beer I could either sit on or skull

countdown.name: Thom Dante’s Inferno
countdown.quote: It’s surprisingly easy to drink and well balanced
countdown.longQuote: Really strong on the candied sugar giving it a sweet finish. It’s surprisingly easy to drink and well balanced. It’s missing some depth of flavour but good overall

countdown.name: Khoi Brewpub Gió Lào Green Rice
countdown.quote: I like the unique green tinge and it has the taste of rice starch and a nice hit of sweetness
countdown.longQuote: I like the unique green tinge and it has the taste of rice starch and a nice hit of sweetness. Still refreshing

countdown.name: 7 Bridges Imperial Double IPA
countdown.quote: Fits surprisingly well in the hot climate
countdown.longQuote: Mellow taste with a lot of orange aroma. Just a little bit of dank at the end. You don’t usually see a west coast this easy to drink

worst.name: Thom Tây Bǎc
worst.quote: Overall so bad I couldn’t finish it
worst.longQuote: This beer is probably past its prime. I had to wait 5 minutes for the frothing to stop and it has a sour taste. Overall so bad I couldn’t finish it
